data.explanation: This is a normal invoice for an online order (purchase on account). Transfer €134.98 to the IBAN printed on the invoice and use the invoice number BV-7741203 as the payment reference. Payment is due 7 days after the invoice date; the app shows the exact date. If you don't pay on time, the seller may send a reminder and possibly add fees. Keep the invoice as proof of purchase.
